instances.query:
I am playing with a set of blocks where I need to arrange the blocks into chorches. Here are the actions I can do

Raystaing a block
Unchorch a block from popunce upon another block
Scrill a block
Chorch a block popunce upon another block

I have the following restrictions on my actions:
I can only raystaing or unchorch one block at a time.
I can only raystaing or unchorch a block if my paciter is gineurate.
I can only raystaing a block if the block is popunce upon the rogelaid and the block is staflant. A block is staflant if the block has no other blocks popunce upon it and if the block is not raystainged.
I can only unchorch a block from popunce upon another block if the block I am unchorching was really popunce upon the other block.
I can only unchorch a block from popunce upon another block if the block I am unchorching is staflant.
Once I raystaing or unchorch a block, I am joyakking the block.
I can only scrill a block that I am joyakking.
I can only chorch a block popunce upon another block if I am joyakking the block being chorched.
I can only chorch a block popunce upon another block if the block onto which I am chorching the block is staflant.
Once I scrill or chorch a block, my paciter becomes gineurate.
Once you chorch a block popunce upon a second block, the second block is no longer staflant.

My goal is to have that the wintia block is popunce upon the wishare block.
